items.q: What will I learn in the 16 weeks?
items.a: Eight modules, from marketing basics and AI copywriting to SEO, social media, Google and Meta Ads, email and WhatsApp marketing and freelancing, ending with a portfolio, resume and mock interview week.

items.q: How many projects will I work on?
items.a: You study 30+ brand case studies and finish with 15+ industry projects, including live campaign work, not just theory.

items.q: What is the fee for the Digital Marketing Course in Bhopal?
items.a: The current fee is ₹22,000 (it was ₹28,000), and EMI is available as 4 monthly installments of ₹5,500. The next batch starts on 11 November 2026, Monday to Saturday, 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM, with only 12 seats. Fill in the enquiry form or WhatsApp +91 84619 58162 for the payment options and to reserve a seat.

items.q: Do I need any marketing or technical background?
items.a: No. No prior marketing experience is needed, and the course starts from the basics.

items.q: Can a working professional or a college student attend?
items.a: Yes. The next batch runs in the evening, Monday to Saturday, 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM, so it fits around college hours or a day job.

items.q: Will I get a certificate and a portfolio?
items.a: Yes. You receive a completion certificate and build your own public portfolio website that shows recruiters real results.
It covers resume building, interview preparation, mock interviews and portfolio guidance, with access to our placement network. Hiring decisions stay with the employers.

items.q: Can I visit the classroom or attend a demo class first?
items.a: Yes. Message us to book a free class or a campus visit at Liberty Plaza, MP Nagar, Bhopal.
Yes. See the online digital marketing course, which runs live with recordings.
